title: Richard: Voice-First Mobile Interaction for Persistent Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2609.39976v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mobile terminals need to provide application and network services while supporting users' control over their attention. We explore voice-first interaction organized around requests and delegated tasks, allowing users to leave a conversation and later inspect, revise, and retrieve the work. We present Richard, a system prototype that manages voice sessions, task execution, and result delivery separately, linking them through persistent request records. Conversation and task views provide visual feedback, while the backend coordinates immediate responses, dedicated service operations, and agent tasks. Request revisions, execution states, and notifications remain associated with the relevant task. We examine this design through Android functional records, controlled lifecycle verification, and execution records of a real programming request. Controlled verification reproduces revision, execution after confirmation, and result retention; d

translated_title: Richard：面向持久化任务的语音优先移动交互
translated_abstract: 移动终端在提供应用与网络服务的同时，还需要支持用户对自身注意力的掌控。我们探索了一种以请求和委托任务为核心的语音优先交互方式，允许用户随时离开对话，之后仍可查看、修改并取回任务成果。我们提出了Richard这一系统原型，它将语音会话、任务执行和结果交付分开管理，并通过持久化的请求记录将三者关联起来。对话视图与任务视图提供视觉反馈，后端则协调即时响应、专用服务操作与智能体任务。请求的修改、执行状态与通知始终与相应任务保持关联。我们通过Android功能记录、受控生命周期验证以及一个真实编程请求的执行记录来检验该设计。受控验证复现了请求修改、确认后执行以及结果留存；
tldr: 提出Richard系统原型，通过持久化请求记录将语音会话、任务执行与结果交付解耦管理，实现语音优先的移动交互，让用户可以离开对话后再查看、修改和取回委托任务的成果。
en_tdlr: Richard is a voice-first mobile interaction prototype that decouples voice sessions, task execution, and result delivery through persistent request records, allowing users to leave a conversation and later inspect, revise, and retrieve delegated task results.
